correctness.rationale: For K_(a_i) with total n the mutually orthogonal spectral projectors E=J/n, B-E and within-part W_i diagonalize the combinatorial Laplacian at 0,n,n-a_i. Evaluating f(hL) produces cross-part entries (1-f(nh))/n, within-part off-diagonal entries proportional to [Φ((n-a_i)h)-Φ(nh)] and diagonal convex-combination entries; 0≤f≤1 and nonincreasing Φ suffice. Necessity comes from K₂ for f≤1, growing cliques at scaled steps for f≥0 and bicliques K_(p,q) with all positive rational ratios for monotonicity of Φ. For the Gauss step f=(s²-6s+12)/(s²+6s+12), numerator=(s-3)²+3>0 and Φ=12/(s²+6s+12) strictly decreases, giving strictly positive, symmetric, stochastic and positive-definite endpoint matrices. Independently inverted 15 rational Padé matrix cases at varied sizes/scales and recovered projectors/positive entries exactly.

Primary positivity work proves short-time sufficient criteria for Hurwitz Metzler systems, not the iff scalar criterion for arbitrary continuous f on all multipartite graphs. Previously described Gauss positivity on a special bipartite graph is not newly credited; the full scalar iff is the novelty claim.
